kind: real-photo collection protocol; not labeled image data
scenarios: contained cat on cluttered bed: no adjustment
observed clipped ears/head: small room correction if full head intended
small cat: useful crop only if context survives
peripheral portrait with negative space: no forced centering
empty landscape: scene-level, no invented box
recommended adjustment: measure subsequent issue, withdraw if worsened
still acceptable composition: ready or silence
manual zoom: cancel AI ramp immediately
splitRule: Split by capture session/source image before calibration. Never tune on held-out images. Export separate held-out metrics.
sequenceRule: Use distinct real images with measured ordered times, not duplicated stills. Annotated object tracks and executed-ramp logs are needed for real tracking and zoom accuracy.
privacy: User-selected local imports only; no automatic upload or training.
